descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-13 Previous Notes · S09 Prior-note labs × date label × today's lab of the same name

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 Labs from a prior note are stored as prior values with that note's date, never as today's panel. Today's value of the same lab is not overwritten, and no prior lab is shown or counted as today's. (UAT TC-13; TFA-92591 AC 1; TFA-92591 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92591 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given Hospital patient with today's labs Creatinine 1.6 and Potassium 4.0 saved today

When Paste note A dated 'Oct 11' (creatinine 1.1, BNP 1250) → Save & Extract. Then paste note B with the date left empty (creatinine 1.0, lactate 2.1) → Save & Extract

Then Cells. A × same name: today's Creatinine 1.6 stays today's, and 1.1 is kept as a prior value dated Oct 11. A × new name: BNP 1250 is shown as a prior value dated Oct 11, never as today's. B × same name: today's 1.6 stays, and 1.0 is kept as prior and never dated today. B × new name: lactate 2.1 is never dated or shown as today's. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): None of the four cells is judged until oracle.mjs can scope a check to the Labs section or a post-run backend read of rounding:get exists. LabsPanel.tsx renders no dates on main, and 'Oct 11' is always on the 'Note · Oct 11' toggle, so page-wide text cannot tell the cells apart. Then, after each import: labs hold Creatinine 1.6 dated today, unchanged; …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S09 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-13.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 25acd72 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-15T14:04:39Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
